title: Two residue functor comparisons for the fixed completed immersion pullback
statement: Let i:S→X be an immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme], [def-weil-closed-immersion], [def-weil-open-immersion], A a Noetherian commutative ring and I an ideal. Use the explicitly normalized completed pullback sfbImmersionCompletedModel [def-sfb-adic-immersion-completed-model]. Let sfbFixedResiduePull be exact fixed-scalar pro-etale inverse image followed by the AsSmall and constant-module equivalences. For every completed complex K, the zeroth scalar extension of sfbImmersionCompletedModel(K) is isomorphic to derived sfbFixedResiduePull applied to sfbResidueComplex(K). For every etale A/I-complex C, this same exact derived functor applied to comparisonUpperStar(C) is isomorphic to adicResidueComparison of the explicit sfbImmersionResidue(C) [lem-sfb-adic-immersion-residue-transport]. Neither assertion requires completeness or an isomorphism presenting the residue of K.

proof.text: Apply the two strictly smaller fixed-model and etale-origin comparison theorems, stated with the core fixed residue pullback that sfbFixedResiduePull abbreviates, and introduce their conjunction.

theorem sfbImmersion_residueComparisons
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (i : S ⟶ X) [IsImmersion i]
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (I : Ideal A) :
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard
      (ConstantCompletion.Mod (ConstantCompletion.constant (proEtaleModelTopology S)
        (A ⧸ I ^ (0 + 1))))
    (∀ K : @DerivedCategory (proEtaleRingModules X (adicLisseCompletedRing X I)) _ _
        (proEtaleRingModules_hasDerivedCategory X (adicLisseCompletedRing X I)),
      Nonempty ((ConstantCompletion.extend
        (ConstantCompletion.projection (proEtaleModelTopology S) A I 0)).obj
          (sfbImmersionCompletedModel i I K) ≅
        (Functor.mapDerivedCategory.{u + 1, u + 2, u + 1, u + 1, u + 2, u + 2}
          (sfbFixedResiduePull i (A ⧸ I ^ (0 + 1)))).obj
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (sfbResidueComplex X I K)))) ∧
    (∀ C : CochainComplex
        (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (A ⧸ I ^ (0 + 1)))) ℤ,
      Nonempty ((Functor.mapDerivedCategory.{u + 1, u + 2, u + 1, u + 1, u + 2, u + 2}
          (sfbFixedResiduePull i (A ⧸ I ^ (0 + 1)))).obj
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
            (((ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar.{u + 2, u}
              (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (A ⧸ I ^ (0 + 1))) X).mapHomologicalComplex
                (.up ℤ)).obj C)) ≅
        (adicResidueComparison.{u, 0} S (A ⧸ I ^ (0 + 1))).obj
          (sfbImmersionResidue i I C)))
